title: Aurora Police Department roster and photos of all sworn officers

communications.subject: Illinois Freedom of Information Act. Request: Aurora Police Department roster and photos of all sworn officers
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Illinois Freedom of Information Act., I hereby request the following records:

The current roster and documents/records containing photos of all sworn APD officers.

These records should be sufficient to show:

Name
Photo or Headshot
Current badge number
Current rank
Unit assignment
Gender
Race
Date of employment
Government email address

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

M

communications.subject: Illinois Freedom of Information Act. Request: Motorola/Vigilant ALPR Sharing
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Illinois Freedom of Information Act., I hereby request the following records:

To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Illinois Freedom of Information Act., I hereby request the following records:

The current (most recent) “Agency Data Sharing Report” generated by the Aurora Police Department's Vigilant Solutions / Motorola LEARN automated license plate reader (ALPR) system.
This report lists (a) the agencies with which the Department shares its ALPR detection data, (b) the agencies from which it receives detection data, and (c) any hot-list sharing and hot-list received.

The report is generated within the LEARN system's administrative interface and can be exported as a PDF. Please provide it in that native electronic format.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,
M
